that honors their memory. Parents often carry grief alongside joy at weddings, and acknowledging missing loved ones is a powerful gesture.

The video you give your parents doesn't have to be the same edit you share on social media. In fact, it probably shouldn't be. A parent-focused version should emphasize different moments and tell a different story.
blog.wedding-video-for-parents.p_text.to: to include their video messages in your wedding film. They can record a blessing, share memories, or simply express their love — all from the comfort of their home.
blog.wedding-video-for-parents.p_text.up: Upload the video to Google Drive or Dropbox and share the link with your parents. This gives them a backup if the USB drive fails and allows them to watch on tablets or phones. Bookmark the link on their devices if possible.
blog.wedding-video-for-parents.p_text.wo: Work with your editor to weave in photos from your childhood — your first day of school, family vacations, holidays — alongside your wedding footage. The parallel between the child you were and the adult you've become is deeply moving for parents.
blog.wedding-video-for-parents.p_text.yo: Your parents don't want another gift card or kitchen appliance. They want to see your face, hear your laughter, and relive the day they gained a new family member.

Your parents gave you life, love, and the foundation for the relationship you're building. A wedding video gift for mom and dad isn't just a nice extra — it's a way of honoring everything they've done and giving them a treasure they'll revisit for decades.

Your parents watched you take your first steps. They sat through your piano recitals. They stayed up worrying when you were out too late. And on your wedding day, they watched you start a new chapter — with tears in their eyes and pride in their hearts.

The most effective wedding video music follows the emotional arc of your day. Think of it as a story with three acts:

The preparation montage is one of the most emotionally rich parts of any wedding video. Hair, makeup, the dress reveal, nervous laughter with your bridal party. This section calls for music that's intimate and personal — acoustic tracks, soft piano, or gentle indie songs work beautifully here.
The reception, first dance, party, and send-off. This is where you can go upbeat and fun. Think feel-good anthems, classic party songs, or a meaningful track that captures the joy of the celebration.

This is the emotional core. Your vows, the ring exchange, the first kiss. Many editors use instrumental music here so the natural audio (your voices, the officiant) can take center stage. If you want a song, choose something with a slow build that peaks at the right moment.
This is where many couples get tripped up. You can't just use any song in your wedding video, especially if you plan to share it online.

This means your wedding video music isn't just background noise — it's a memory trigger. Years from now, hearing that song on the radio should transport you back to your wedding day. That's why getting it right matters.

blog.wedding-video-music.p_text.royalty_: "Royalty-free" doesn't mean free of cost — it means you pay once and can use the music without ongoing royalties. Most royalty-free libraries charge $15–$50 per track for a standard license that covers personal videos, social media, and web use.
blog.wedding-video-music.p_text.some_art: Some artists release music under Creative Commons licenses that allow free use in videos, often with attribution. The quality varies widely, but there are excellent tracks available if you know where to look.
blog.wedding-video-music.p_text.sometime: Sometimes the most powerful audio in a wedding video isn't music at all — it's your vows, a loved one's toast, or your grandmother's voice. Layering these real audio moments over ambient music creates an incredibly emotional effect.

blog.wedding-video-music.p_text.use_volu: Use volume automation or "ducking" to reduce music volume when someone is speaking. A good rule of thumb: drop music to 15-25% of its original volume during dialogue, then bring it back up during non-speech moments. Most editing software has automatic ducking features.
blog.wedding-video-music.p_text.when_you: When you purchase a song on iTunes or stream it on Spotify, you're buying a personal listening license — not the right to use that music in a video. Syncing music with video requires a separate "synchronization license" that's typically only available to production companies and can cost hundreds or thousands of dollars per song.

blog.wedding-video-types-guide.p_text.a_: A cartoon-style recreation of the couple's love story or wedding day. Fun, unique, and completely different from traditional wedding video.
A cinematic video captured during a pre-wedding or engagement photoshoot. Often features the couple in scenic locations, set to music.

A close-focus video of just the vow exchange. Intimate, emotional, and deeply personal. Can be combined with a [family tribute video](/services/absence-compensation/family-tribute/) for a powerful emotional experience.

A condensed, cinematic version of the day, featuring only the best moments set to music. Typically 3-10 minutes. This is the most popular type of wedding video and the one most couples share on social media.
A condensed version of the ceremony, featuring the processional, key moments (vows, rings, kiss), and recessional. Typically 3-5 minutes.
A dedicated video of the first dance, often with slow-motion enhancement. Can include preparation footage and guest reactions.
A dedicated video of toasts and speeches. Captures the words, emotions, and reactions. Can be edited to combine multiple speeches into one video.
A fun, humorous video that plays on wedding tropes, inside jokes, or trending formats. Not every wedding video needs to be serious — sometimes funny is better.
A gravação completa da cerimônia — entrada, votos, alianças, primeiro beijo, saída. Pode ser editada ou deixada na íntegra.
A gravação do momento do pedido — seja planejado ou surpresa. Pode ser filmado por um videógrafo escondido, drones ou câmeras fixas.

A highlight video created and shown during the wedding reception itself. The videographer films the ceremony and afternoon, then quickly edits a highlight reel to play at the reception. Incredibly impactful but requires skilled editing under pressure.

A narrative-driven video that tells the couple's love story through interviews, footage, photos, and creative editing. More artistic and personal than a standard highlight reel. Typically 5-15 minutes.
A series of short clips (15 seconds each) designed for Instagram Stories. Can be released throughout the wedding day as a live narrative.
A series of short videos counting down to the wedding day. Released at regular intervals (daily, weekly, or monthly) to build excitement.
A short (15-90 seconds), trendy edit optimized for social media. Features quick cuts, popular audio, text overlays, and platform-specific formatting.
A short, shareable video announcing the wedding date. Often features the couple, the date, and a brief message. 15-60 seconds.
A short, teaser-style video (1-3 minutes) that builds anticipation for the full video. Often released before the full video to generate excitement. Cinematic, dramatic, and emotionally charged.

A versão condensada e cinematográfica do dia, apresentando apenas os melhores momentos ao som de música. Geralmente 3-10 minutos. Este é o tipo mais popular de vídeo de casamento e o que a maioria dos casais compartilha nas redes sociais.

A versão em vídeo do convite tradicional de casamento, incluindo todos os detalhes essenciais (data, horário, local, confirmação de presença). Pode ser formal ou casual dependendo do estilo do casamento.
A video capturing reactions to the wedding video — parents watching for the first time, friends seeing the proposal, grandparents reliving the ceremony. These reactions become part of the story.
A video compilation of messages from family members who couldn't attend the wedding. They record their well-wishes in advance, and the video is played at the reception.
A video created entirely from wedding photos — no video footage required. Photos are enhanced with transitions, effects, music, and text to create a dynamic, engaging video.
A video documenting the engagement — either the proposal itself or a post-engagement celebration. Often used as an engagement announcement.
A video featuring the couple's pets in wedding-themed settings. Can be a standalone video or incorporated into the main wedding video.
A video honoring family members — those present and those who have passed. Combines family photos, old videos, and wedding footage to celebrate the families that shaped the couple.

A video version of the traditional wedding invitation, including all essential details (date, time, location, RSVP). Can be formal or casual depending on the wedding style. Our [wedding invitation video guide](/blog/wedding-invitation-video-guide/) covers this thoroughly.
A wedding video edited to look like it was shot on vintage film — with grain, color shifts, and retro effects. Nostalgic and romantic.
A wedding video with subtitles or narration in multiple languages. Essential for multicultural weddings where guests speak different languages.
blog.wedding-video-types-guide.p_text.ae: Aerial footage of the venue, landscape, and outdoor moments. Creates dramatic, sweeping visuals that ground-level cameras can't achieve.
blog.wedding-video-types-guide.p_text.an: An energetic, music-driven video of the dance floor. Fast cuts, upbeat music, and lots of energy. Captures the fun and celebration of the reception.
An unedited recording of the entire ceremony. Captures every word, every moment, every reaction. Priceless for family members who couldn't attend.

blog.wedding-video-types-guide.p_text.qu: Quand on pense « vidéo de mariage », la plupart des gens imaginent un long film de 2 heures avec toute la cérémonie en continu. Mais en 2026, la vidéo de mariage est un univers infiniment plus riche et varié.

Quando a maioria das pessoas pensa em "vídeo de casamento", imagina uma coisa: uma gravação longa de todo o dia do casamento. Mas os vídeos de casamento evoluíram drasticamente. Em 2026, existem dezenas de tipos distintos de vídeos de casamento, cada um servindo a um propósito diferente, contando uma história diferente e atraindo uma audiência diferente.

Que vous cherchiez un trailer percutant pour les réseaux sociaux, un film émouvant pour les générations futures, ou un hommage touchant pour vos proches absents — il existe un format parfait pour vous.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Des clips au ralenti des invités : réactions, danses, interactions.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Des messages vidéo enregistrés par les proches qui n'ont pas pu assister au mariage.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Des mèmes personnalisés créés à partir de vos photos et clips de mariage.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Des séquences aériennes du lieu de mariage et des environs, capturées par drone.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** La séquence de la découpe du gâteau, souvent avec des réactions amusantes.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Le condensé des meilleurs moments en 3-7 minutes. C'est LA vidéo que vous partagerez le plus.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Le film de votre demande en mariage, capturé en secret ou mis en scène après coup.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Le film des heures précédant la cérémonie : maquillage, coiffure, habillage, émotion de la famille.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Le montage de tous les discours du mariage (témoins, parents, amis).
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** L'enregistrement intégral de la cérémonie, sans coupure.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** L'équivalent vidéo de l'invitation papier, avec tous les détails du mariage (date, lieu, dress code, RSVP).
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film artistique de 15-45 minutes qui raconte la journée entière avec un style cinématographique.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film créé pour un anniversaire de mariage (1 an, 5 ans, 10 ans…), combinant photos du mariage et souvenirs des années écoulées.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film dédié aux messages et vœux des parents aux mariés.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film dédié à votre première danse, avec des angles multiples et du slow-motion.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film de mariage avec le style visuel d'un film hollywoodien (color grading, mouvements de caméra, musique orchestrale).
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un film mettant en vedette votre chien, chat ou autre compagnon dans votre mariage.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un hommage vidéo aux personnes importantes (défunts, grands-parents, parrains/marraines).
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un message vidéo personnalisé d'une célébrité ou d'une personnalité pour les mariés.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Un montage animé de vos plus belles photos, avec musique et transitions.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une bande-annonce de votre mariage en 60-90 secondes, comme un trailer de film.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une courte vidéo (30-60 secondes) envoyée aux invités pour leur demander de bloquer la date de votre mariage.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une séance vidéo tournée avant le mariage, souvent dans un lieu significatif pour le couple.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une version courte (1-2 minutes) destinée au site web du mariage ou aux réseaux sociaux.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une vidéo immersive à 360° permettant au spectateur de regarder dans toutes les directions.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une vidéo ludique pour annoncer la nouvelle de vos fiançailles ou de la date du mariage sur les réseaux sociaux.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Une vidéo où le couple remercie ses invités pour leur présence et leurs cadeaux.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Vos clips et photos restaurés et traités dans un style vintage/rétro (Super 8, noir et blanc, grain).
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Votre histoire de mariage racontée en animation cartoon/dessin animé.
**Qu'est-ce que c'est ?** Votre vidéo de mariage avec sous-titres ou narration dans plusieurs langues.

Um vídeo de destaques criado e exibido durante a própria festa de casamento. O videógrafo filma a cerimônia e a tarde, depois edita rapidamente um highlight reel para tocar na festa. Extremamente impactante, mas exige edição habilidosa sob pressão.
Um vídeo focado exclusivamente no momento de se preparar — maquiagem, cabelo, vestido, terno, nervosismo, risadas com os padrinhos.
Um vídeo narrativo que conta a história de amor do casal através de entrevistas, filmagens, fotos e edição criativa. Mais artístico e pessoal do que um highlight reel padrão. Geralmente 5-15 minutos.
Uma homenagem aos entes queridos — presentes ou ausentes. Combina fotos antigas, vídeos caseiros e memórias em uma narrativa emocionante sobre a história da família.
Uma montagem do vídeo do casamento com atualizações do primeiro ano juntos — viagens, mudanças, conquistas.
Uma sessão de vídeo durante o noivado, mostrando o casal em diferentes locais e situações. Usualmente mais descontraído e criativo que as filmagens do dia do casamento.
blog.wedding-video-types-guide.p_text.un: Un clip corto y repetible (5-15 segundos) diseñado como GIF animado o video loop para usar como estado de WhatsApp o para enviar a familiares.

Un formato más largo (20-45 minutos) que no solo muestra el evento, sino que cuenta la historia de la pareja: cómo se conocieron, la propuesta, la preparación de la boda, y el día en sí. Incluye entrevistas y narración.
Un mensaje personalizado de una celebridad (o una IA que simula una) para sorprender a la pareja o a un familiar. Puede ser desde un personaje famoso hasta un actor que interpreta a alguien especial.
Un montaje dinámico de los momentos más divertidos de la pista de baile. Edición rápida, música energética, risas y baile. Duración: 2-5 minutos.
Un tipo especial de video de deseos centrado en los mensajes de los padres de ambos novios. Profundamente personal y emotivo, a menudo es el video más valorado de todos.
Un video con subtítulos o narración en múltiples idiomas. Perfecto para parejas internacionales o familias multiculturales donde los invitados hablan diferentes idiomas.

Un video editado que se presenta durante la recepción, generalmente durante la cena. El videógrafo graba por la mañana y edita durante la tarde para mostrar un resumen de la ceremonia a todos los invitados. Es un momento muy emotivo.
Un video homenaje a familiares que han fallecido o que no pueden asistir. Incluye fotos, videos anteriores y mensajes emotivos. Se suele proyectar durante la ceremonia o recepción.
Un video humorístico basado en memes populares, usando fotos y clips de la boda. Perfecto para compartir en el grupo de WhatsApp de los invitados o en redes sociales después del evento.
Un video protagonizado por tus mascotas. La IA puede integrar a tus perros, gatos u otras mascotas en escenas de la boda, como si fueran invitados de honor. Tiernos y divertidos.
Un video que recorre la historia de la pareja desde que se conocieron hasta la boda. Incluye fotos antiguas, videos caseros, mensajes de texto históricos y momentos clave de la relación.
Una alternativa creativa al "save the date" tradicional en papel. Un clip corto (30-60 segundos) donde la pareja anuncia la fecha de la boda de forma original y divertida.
Una estación o app donde los invitados graban mensajes de buenos deseos para la pareja. Se compila después en un video emotivo que puede durar desde 5 minutos hasta media hora.

Una presentación de las mejores fotos de la boda, la relación y los momentos previos, animada con transiciones elegantes, efecto de movimiento (efecto Ken Burns) y música emotiva. Duración: 3-8 minutos.

Una secuencia acelerada que muestra la preparación y evolución del lugar de la boda, desde el montaje vacío hasta la fiesta llena de gente. También funciona para capturar la llegada de invitados o el atardecer.
Una serie de clips cortos que cuentan la historia del día en formato de Stories. Cada clip dura 15 segundos y se publica secuencialmente, creando una narrativa en tiempo real.
Una versión artística del video editada completamente en blanco y negro o con secciones monocromáticas. Añade elegancia atemporal y un toque artístico.

blog.weddingai-video-guide.p_text.ce_que: **Ce que c'est :** Ce service crée un segment dédié aux proches absents (décédés, empêchés) en intégrant des photos, vidéos et messages existants dans un hommage émouvant.
**Ce que c'est :** Créez des messages vidéo personnalisés de proches qui n'ont pas pu assister au mariage. L'IA peut même générer des messages à partir de photos et d'enregistrements audio existants.
**Ce que c'est :** Le service le plus fun de WeddingAI. Obtenez un message vidéo personnalisé d'une célébrité (acteur, chanteur, personnalité publique) pour votre mariage.
**Ce que c'est :** Le service principal de WeddingAI. Upload de vos séquences brutes, génération automatique d'un montage professionnel complet.

**Ce que c'est :** L'IA analyse vos séquences et identifie les moments qui bénéficieraient d'un effet de ralenti — l'échange des alliances, le lancer de bouquet, la première danse, un regard complice. Elle applique ensuite le slow-motion de manière fluide et naturelle.
**Ce que c'est :** L'IA identifie les moments drôles de votre mariage et crée automatiquement des mèmes partageables sur les réseaux sociaux.
**Ce que c'est :** Pour les couples de cultures différentes, ce service génère des versions de votre vidéo dans plusieurs langues — sous-titrage, voix-off, ou textes à l'écran.
**Ce que c'est :** Transformez certaines de vos séquences en version animée/cartoon pour un rendu unique et ludique. Parfait pour des moments fun ou comme complément à une vidéo classique.

**Ce que c'est :** Une version courte et percutante (1-3 minutes) de votre mariage, conçue pour les réseaux sociaux et le partage rapide. L'IA sélectionne les moments les plus forts et crée une bande-annonce cinématique.

**Ce que c'est :** Votre chien, chat ou autre animal de compagnie était présent à votre mariage ? Ce service l'intègre comme élément central du montage, avec des plans dédiés et un traitement spécial.

**Ce que c'est :** Vous avez des vidéos VHS, Hi8, MiniDV ou des films Super 8 du mariage de vos parents ou grands-parents ? Ce service les restaure et les modernise pour les intégrer à votre vidéo de mariage.

homepage_faq.q5.text: If you're not satisfied with the result, we'll revise it twice at no extra cost. Full refund is available if we can't meet your requirements after revisions.

homepage_faq.q6.text: Your footage is stored encrypted on secure US-based servers. Files are automatically deleted 30 days after delivery. You can request earlier deletion at any time by emailing privacy@weddingai.video. We never share your footage with third parties without written consent.

order.p_text.step2_sample_footage_desc.7: For restoration, AI generation, or trailer services, we ask for a 30-60 second sample clip to verify the source quality and confirm the service will deliver the expected result. This is free and takes 1-2 business days.
order.p_text.step3_quote_desc.22afeabd: You receive a detailed quote with: the recommended service(s), exact pricing, timeline, deliverables list, and any options or upsells. No hidden fees. The quote is yours to accept or decline — no pressure.
order.p_text.step4_confirm_start_desc.22: Once you accept (usually by replying "go ahead"), we send a short intake form for upload links, branding preferences, and any special requirements. Production starts within 1-2 business days of intake.
order.p_text.step5_drafts_final_desc.a8e: For most services, you get a draft within 3-7 days. You can request changes (2 rounds included). Final files are delivered in your preferred format — typically MP4 for video, MP3 for audio, plus any social-media-specific cuts.

pricing_faq.q1.name: Why is the price a range instead of a flat fee?
pricing_faq.q1.text: Every project is different. A 5-minute VHS tape and a 3-hour 4K wedding film are not the same work. We quote based on footage length, complexity, and turnaround. The $9.9 starting price is the entry point for each service; the final quote reflects your project's actual scope.
pricing_faq.q2.name: Do you charge hourly?
pricing_faq.q2.text: Never. We charge per project. You'll know the exact price before we start — and the price won't change unless you add scope.
pricing_faq.q3.name: Are there hidden fees?
pricing_faq.q3.text: No. File delivery, format conversion, and 2 rounds of revisions are included in every project. The only time the price changes is if you ask for additional work after delivery.
pricing_faq.q4.name: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing_faq.q4.text: All major credit cards (via Stripe), PayPal, and bank transfer for projects over $1,000. Invoices are sent on delivery; payment is due within 14 days.
pricing_faq.q5.name: Can I get a refund if I'm not happy?
pricing_faq.q5.text: Yes. Two free revisions are included with every service. If after revisions you're still not happy, we offer a full refund. We've processed over 500 projects and refunded fewer than 5.
pricing_faq.q6.name: Do you offer discounts for non-profits or destination weddings?
pricing_faq.q6.text: Sometimes. If your wedding serves a charitable cause (e.g. a vow-renewal fundraiser) or you have a tight story to tell, mention it in the form — we'll see what we can do.

resources.li_text.15_000_documentary_sty: $15,000+: Documentary-style production (think "the kind of wedding video that wins Vimeo Staff Picks"). Real cinematic production. Worth it if you're making a film, not just a record.
resources.li_text.16mm_silent_era_throug: 16mm (silent era through 1980s): Recoverable with caveats. Higher resolution than 8mm, so more detail to work with. Slightly less color fading.
resources.li_text.1_500_3_000_two_videog: $1,500-$3,000: Two videographers, 8-10 hours, highlight reel (3-7 min) + full ceremony. The most common "mid-tier" range. Solid quality, no surprises.
resources.li_text.3_000_6_000_two_videog: $3,000-$6,000: Two videographers + audio tech, 10-12 hours, cinematic trailer (1-3 min) + full documentary edit, drone footage, multiple cameras. This is "real professional."
resources.li_text.500_1_500_single_video: $500-$1,500: Single videographer, 6-8 hours, documentary edit, 30-60 day delivery. Entry-level. Usually a solo operator with a consumer camera and basic editing software.
resources.li_text.6_000_15_000_full_prod: $6,000-$15,000: Full production team, multiple cameras, custom color grading, licensed music, same-day edit teaser, drone. Luxury tier. Worth it for high-budget weddings.
8mm / Super 8 (1965-1990): Recoverable but trickier. The film itself is degrading. Color fades to magenta over time. We digitize, then AI color-restore.
resources.li_text.all_inclusive_package_: "All-inclusive package" — usually means everything is basic. Ask for line items.
resources.li_text.archive_quality_4k_out: Archive-quality (4K output, colorist, audio engineer): $800-$1,500 per tape. For irreplaceable footage only.
resources.li_text.audio_quality_if_you_c: Audio quality. If you can't hear the vows over wind noise, they'll butcher your vows too.
resources.li_text.audio_restoration.3779: Audio restoration. AI denoising + EQ + spectral repair (for specific clicks and pops). We don't overdo this — old audio has character.
resources.li_text.betamax_1975_1985.9088: Betamax (1975-1985): Mostly recoverable. Similar to VHS but with mechanical issues that need professional handling.
resources.li_text.build_a_family_memoria: Build a family memorial video for future anniversaries. If you have old footage (your parents' wedding, your grandparents' wedding), weave it together with yours. Your 25th anniversary video becomes a 50-year story.
resources.li_text.can_i_see_a_full_weddi: "Can I see a full wedding film from someone with my venue type?" — Outdoor vs indoor lighting is a huge difference.
resources.li_text.cinematic_trailer_1_3_: Cinematic trailer (1-3 minutes): Hollywood-style teaser, slow motion, color grading. This is what most "cinematic wedding videographer" portfolios actually show.
resources.li_text.cleanup.51169298: Cleanup. AI removes grain, tape hiss, and tracking artifacts. We do this carefully — over-cleaned video looks fake.
resources.li_text.color_grading_as_a_sep: "Color grading as a separate line item." Good color grading should be included in the editing cost. If they're charging extra, ask why.
resources.li_text.color_grading_look_at_: Color grading. Look at skin tones — if they look orange or green, the editor is bad.
resources.li_text.color_restoration.9464: Color restoration. The hardest part. AI does the heavy lifting (auto color, white balance) but a human editor makes the final calls. A 1985 magenta-faded wedding is not the same as a 1990 yellow-faded one.
resources.li_text.coverage_variety_a_gre: Coverage variety. A great wedding video has wide shots, close-ups, and detail shots. Not just one angle.
resources.li_text.create_a_best_of_highl: Create a "best of" highlight reel for Instagram. 30-60 seconds, vertical, captioned. Pin it to your profile for the first year of marriage.
resources.li_text.create_a_private_youtu: Create a private YouTube channel for your family. Upload the full wedding video + the highlight reel + the trailers. Share the link with everyone who was there. They'll re-share it for years.
resources.li_text.create_a_thank_you_mes: Create a thank-you message for guests. Use the best moments from each table/table-group into a 2-minute "thank you" video. Send it as a private YouTube link with a personal message.
resources.li_text.day_of_shoot_40_50.638: Day-of shoot (40-50%): The videographer(s) on site. 8-12 hours at $50-$300/hour per shooter.
resources.li_text.digitization.07243523: Digitization. We use professional-grade VCRs (not consumer ones) with time-base correctors. The output is a clean digital file at 720x480.
resources.li_text.do_you_mic_the_groom.9: "Do you mic the groom?" — Wireless lapel mic on the groom is non-negotiable. If they don't, skip.
resources.li_text.do_you_use_the_same_mu: "Do you use the same music as the venue's DJ?" — If yes, ask who pays the licensing fee. Surprise: usually you do.
resources.li_text.documentary_3_6_hours_: Documentary (3-6 hours, full ceremony + reception): Traditional wedding videography. Coverage of the day, edited into a long-form film. Most "wedding videographers" do this.
resources.li_text.drone_footage.22660809: Drone footage. Beautiful but rarely essential. Most venues have aerial shots in their marketing already.
resources.li_text.drone_work_is_extra_at: Drone work is "extra" at most companies. A 30-second drone shot adds $300-$500 to your bill. Worth asking if it's included.
resources.li_text.equipment_amortization: Equipment amortization (5-10%): Cameras, lenses, gimbals, audio gear, drones. Pro gear costs $20K+ and depreciates over 3-5 years.
resources.li_text.footage_that_was_recor: Footage that was recorded over. If your dad taped Monday Night Football over your parents' wedding, that footage is gone.
resources.li_text.highlight_reel_3_7_min: Highlight reel (3-7 minutes): A short film of the best moments, set to music. The most popular style now.
resources.li_text.how_many_weddings_have: "How many weddings have you shot solo?" — 50+ minimum. If less, ask who's their backup.
resources.li_text.hybrid.90489347: Hybrid: A short trailer + a longer full ceremony film. Best of both worlds.
resources.li_text.i_ll_send_you_the_raw_: "I'll send you the raw footage for free." Translation: they're not editing it, and you don't have the software/skill to either.
resources.li_text.is_drone_footage_inclu: "Is drone footage included, and is it licensed?" — Drone work requires a Part 107 license. No license = illegal flight = risk of shutdown mid-shot.
resources.li_text.make_20_30_gifs_and_me: Make 20-30 GIFs and memes for the group chat. Aunt Linda's shocked face, the best man's reaction, your dad's dance moves. Send them to the family group chat on a slow Tuesday. You'll become the family legend.
resources.li_text.make_a_30_second_loop_: Make a 30-second loop of your vows. Just the audio. The visual is a single still from the moment. Set it as a phone wallpaper. Every time you unlock your phone, you remember why you married this person.
resources.li_text.make_a_5_minute_greate: Make a 5-minute "greatest hits" for your home TV. Loop it on a screensaver or smart display. Every dinner party, the video plays in the background.
resources.li_text.make_a_first_dance_onl: Make a "first dance" only version. Just the song, the dance, the reactions. 3-4 minutes. Send it to the people on the dance floor — they didn't get to see themselves from the outside.
resources.li_text.make_the_1987_style_vh: Make the 1987-style VHS "playable." Some families have older relatives who won't navigate a streaming service. Burn the highlight reel to a USB stick and put it in a box that looks like a vintage tape. They get to feel like it's 1987 again.
resources.li_text.minidv_hi8_1995_2010.6: MiniDV / Hi8 (1995-2010): Best case. Digital format means less degradation. Just needs transfer and light color correction.
resources.li_text.mold_eaten_or_physical: Mold-eaten or physically shredded tape. If the magnetic tape is physically destroyed, no software can save it.
resources.li_text.music_licensing_5_10.6: Music licensing (5-10%): Premium music costs $50-$500 per song. Lots of videographers use YouTube-free music that's actually infringing (you'll get muted on social media).
resources.li_text.music_rights_don_t_tra: Music rights don't transfer. If the music in your wedding video is licensed to the videographer (most professional music is), you can't use the video commercially without re-licensing. "Personal use" is fine, but you can't put it on a venue's website, sell it, or use it in ads.
resources.li_text.one_year_anniversary_p: One year anniversary post. Pull one still frame from the best moment, share it on your anniversary every year. People will look forward to it.
resources.li_text.output.21536691: Output. 1080p MP4 by default. 4K available. Original digital file archived for 30 days.
resources.li_text.pay_50_upfront_50_on_d: "Pay 50% upfront, 50% on delivery" — standard. Anything more aggressive (like 100% upfront) is risky.
resources.li_text.post_a_15_second_verti: Post a 15-second vertical "first look" reveal. TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts. The single best-performing format for wedding content.
resources.li_text.post_a_behind_the_scen: Post a "behind the scenes" reel. The videographer's BTS footage, the getting-ready moments, the candid reactions. More authentic than the polished edit.
Post-production (30-40%): The editing. 30-80 hours of work for a 5-minute highlight reel. This is where the actual value is — and where cheap videographers cut corners.
resources.li_text.pre_production_5_10_of: Pre-production (5-10% of cost): Pre-wedding calls, venue visit, shot list. Often skipped by lower-tier videographers.
resources.li_text.prices_way_below_marke: Prices way below market for your area — either they're inexperienced, they're about to go out of business, or there are hidden fees.
Prices way below market (under $1,500 for full day). Either they're inexperienced, or there's a hidden cost.
resources.li_text.print_a_30_page_photo_: Print a 30-page photo book with QR codes to video moments. At each photo, add a QR code linking to the corresponding video moment. The book is the index; the video is the experience.
resources.li_text.professional_ai_restor: Professional AI restoration: $200-$500 per tape. The right answer for most families.
resources.li_text.raw_footage_isn_t_actu: "Raw footage" isn't actually free. If your videographer gives you the "raw files" (un-edited), you need a 4TB external drive ($80) and a computer that can edit 4K video ($2,000+). Otherwise, you can't open them.
resources.li_text.same_day_edit.57561765: Same-day edit. Impressive but the video still exists 5 years from now. The "wow factor" of seeing it at the reception is short-lived.
resources.li_text.same_day_edit_is_a_1_0: "Same-day edit" is a $1,000+ upsell. The videographer who stays an extra 4 hours after the wedding to edit a 3-minute teaser for the reception. Impressive but expensive.
resources.li_text.second_shooter.9426517: Second shooter. A single great shooter beats two mediocre ones. If the price forces a choice, pick the better solo videographer.
resources.li_text.send_a_30_second_trail: Send a 30-second trailer to the people who couldn't come. A 30-second vertical video is the right length to text to cousins who live abroad. They get to feel included without sitting through a 10-minute film.
resources.li_text.severely_water_damaged: Severely water-damaged footage. After 24-48 hours underwater, recovery requires specialized (expensive) clean-room services.
resources.li_text.stabilization_shaky_fo: Stabilization. Shaky footage = inexperienced shooter. Gimbal or Steadicam is the standard now.
resources.li_text.starting_at_500_usuall: "Starting at $500" — usually means $500 for a 3-minute highlight with no audio polish.
resources.li_text.the_4k_deliverable.879: The 4K deliverable. 1080p is fine for 99% of viewing contexts. You don't need 4K unless you're projecting on a wall.
resources.li_text.they_film_with_one_cam: They film with one camera, no audio plan. A single shooter with no audio backup is gambling with your only record of the day.
resources.li_text.they_won_t_give_you_re: They won't give you references. Or they give you only friends.
resources.li_text.travel_fees_for_destin: Travel fees for destination weddings. Standard. Just confirm the cost upfront.
resources.li_text.upscaling.03585765: Upscaling. Topaz Video Enhance AI or similar tools upscale 480p to 1080p or 4K. This is where modern AI really shines.
resources.li_text.use_a_still_as_your_ho: Use a still as your holiday card photo. One frame from the video, professionally printed. More personal than a posed shot.
resources.li_text.vhs_to_digital_just_di: VHS to digital (just digitization, no restoration): $25-$50 per tape at a local service. Quality varies wildly.
resources.li_text.vhs_vhs_c_1976_2005.74: VHS / VHS-C (1976-2005): Highly recoverable. AI upscaling from 480p to 1080p is excellent. Color restoration is solid. The biggest issue is tracking errors and tape damage — usually fixable.
resources.li_text.vhs_with_major_trackin: VHS with major tracking errors throughout. Some tapes are so worn that the playback is unwatchable — and the original signal is unrecoverable.
resources.li_text.what_happens_if_your_c: "What happens if your camera fails mid-ceremony?" — They should have a backup camera on standby. Most pros do.
resources.li_text.what_s_included_in_the: "What's included in the package, exactly?" — Get a line-item list. Hours of coverage, number of videographers, delivery format, music licensing.
resources.li_text.when_do_i_get_the_fina: "When do I get the final video, and what's the revision policy?" — Industry standard: 8-12 weeks delivery, 1-2 revision rounds included.

resources.li_text.you_have_a_3_000_budge: You have a $3,000+ budget and care about the result 10+ years from now

resources.li_text.you_have_raw_footage_t: You have raw footage that wasn't edited well and want a professional cut
resources.li_text.you_need_multilingual_: You need multilingual versions for international family
resources.li_text.you_want_a_creative_re: You want a creative reinterpretation (Ghibli style, Pixar style, etc.)
resources.li_text.you_want_a_real_human_: You want a real human making creative decisions on the day
resources.li_text.you_want_consistent_sh: You want consistent shot quality throughout the day
resources.li_text.your_venue_has_tricky_: Your venue has tricky lighting (dark churches, mixed indoor/outdoor)
resources.meta_description.in_depth_wedd: In-depth wedding video guides: choose a videographer, AI wedding films, restore old footage, pricing breakdown, and 15 creative ways to use your wedding video.
resources.p_text.a_wedding_video_that_si: A wedding video that sits in a folder is a memory that fades. A wedding video that gets watched — even 30 seconds at a time, once a year — stays alive. Plan for at least 3 specific uses before the wedding. If you don't plan, the video will sit in a folder.
resources.p_text.ai_video_tools_have_mad: AI video tools have made it possible to create wedding films in ways that weren't realistic 3 years ago. But the marketing is often 5 years ahead of the reality. Here's what AI wedding videos actually do well, where they fall short, and when to use them.
resources.p_text.ai_wedding_video_is_a_9: AI wedding video is a 9/10 solution for the 80% of couples who didn't have (or couldn't afford) a real videographer. It's a 6/10 solution for the 20% who had one but want to fix specific issues. If you can afford a real videographer for the day, do that — and use AI for the things traditional videography doesn't solve (restoration, multilingual, style transfer).
resources.p_text.already_have_raw_footag: Already have raw footage and want it edited professionally?
resources.p_text.already_have_raw_weddin: Already have raw wedding footage and want a professional edit?
resources.p_text.be_honest_with_yourself: Be honest with yourself. If you'll only watch a 3-minute film, don't pay for a 6-hour documentary.
resources.p_text.before_shopping_for_vid: Before shopping for videographers, get clear on the deliverable. Most couples don't, and end up disappointed because their expectations were someone else's. The four most common styles:
resources.p_text.five_in_depth_guides_to: Five in-depth guides to help you make better decisions about your wedding video — from choosing a videographer to restoring old footage, with honest talk about pricing, AI, and what actually works.
resources.p_text.for_a_wedding_with_a_no: For a wedding with a normal guest count and a normal budget: $2,500-$4,000 gets you a great wedding video. Below $1,500, you sacrifice post-production quality. Above $8,000, you're paying for things you don't need. Spend the difference on something you'll see every day (the wedding video) rather than something you'll see once (the chair covers).
resources.p_text.get_the_in_between_mome: Get the in-between moments. AI can't capture the look on your grandmother's face when you walk down the aisle. The candid tears during the father-daughter dance. The unexpected toast. These are the moments that matter most, and they only exist if someone was there with a camera.
resources.p_text.have_old_wedding_tapes_: Have old wedding tapes that need restoration?
resources.p_text.have_photos_but_no_vide: Have photos but no video? See what AI can do.
resources.p_text.if_the_tape_plays_at_al: If the tape plays at all → digitize + AI restore ($200-$500). If the tape has damage → professional service with physical cleaning (extra $50-$100). If the tape is unplayable → call a data recovery lab before giving up, but be prepared for the worst. Either way, do it now — not in 5 years.
resources.p_text.ignore_wedding_videogra: Ignore wedding videographer branding ("cinematic", "luxury", "artistic") — those words mean nothing. Watch 3 full wedding films, not highlight reels. Highlight reels are the best 3 minutes of an 8-hour shoot. The full film shows you what you'll actually get.
resources.p_text.match_a_4k_cinematic_sh: Match a 4K cinematic shoot at $500. The current state of the art can do amazing things, but it can't replace a $5,000-$10,000 cinematic production with a team of videographers. The difference shows in shot composition, lighting decisions in real time, and creative problem-solving on the day.
resources.p_text.most_couples_get_their_: Most couples get their wedding video, watch it once on the couch with a glass of wine, save it to a hard drive, and never open it again. Here's how to actually use it.
resources.p_text.play_it_once_and_digiti: play it once and digitize it . The magnetic signal on VHS and 8mm is degrading every year. Five more years of sitting in a box can mean the difference between "slightly faded" and "unplayable."
resources.p_text.reconstruct_someone_who: Reconstruct someone who passed. AI can activate a still photo (subtle movement, blink, smile), and it can use audio recordings to reconstruct a voice. But the results are stylized, not realistic. Don't let anyone sell you "we'll bring grandma back" — what we do is honor her memory with a tasteful, respectful activation. The expectations gap is where families get hurt.
resources.p_text.red_flags.03707568: Red flags: "We'll restore your footage for $50" is almost always just digitization, no AI. "Unlimited revisions" usually means they did nothing the first time. "We use AI" without specifying which tool usually means they're using a consumer app.
resources.p_text.replace_a_real_videogra: Replace a real videographer at the wedding. AI works with footage that exists. If your cousin "got some shots on their phone" — that's 4 minutes of shaky vertical video. AI can't manufacture the footage that wasn't shot. The most common disappointment: couples hoping AI can fix the fact that they didn't hire a videographer. It can't add a missing ceremony.
resources.p_text.restore_degraded_footag: Restore degraded footage. VHS, 8mm, 16mm — all formats that were essentially write-offs 5 years ago are now recoverable. AI can upscale 480p VHS to look like 1080p, color-correct for faded film, and denoise grainy audio. We restored a 1987 wedding that the family thought was gone forever.
resources.p_text.slow_motion_from_standa: Slow motion from standard footage. Your videographer shot at 30fps? AI can interpolate to 120fps or 240fps. The result is buttery smooth slow motion that wasn't in the original footage.
resources.p_text.style_transfer.51006852: Style transfer. Turn your real wedding video into Studio Ghibli, Pixar 3D, anime, watercolor, or comic book style. The output is novel and shareable, not just decorative.
resources.p_text.the_good_news_most_old_: The good news: most old wedding footage is more recoverable than people think. We've restored tapes from 1962, 1987, and 1995 that the family had given up on. Here's a quick guide by format:
resources.p_text.the_line_items_that_go_: The line items that go into a wedding video:
resources.p_text.the_wrong_videographer_: The wrong videographer costs you $3,000-$8,000 and the only memories of a day you can never re-do. The right one is the difference between a video you watch once and a film you watch every anniversary. Here's how to pick.
resources.p_text.translation_and_voiceov: Translation and voiceover. 20+ languages with both subtitles and AI voiceover that mimics the original speaker's accent. For international families, this is genuinely useful.
resources.p_text.turn_still_photos_into_: Turn still photos into a moving film. This is the biggest one. If you have 30-100 photos from a wedding where you didn't hire a videographer, modern AI can create a 2-5 minute film that looks like a real wedding video. Not a slideshow — an actual film with camera movements, transitions, and music synced to beats. We've shipped 100+ of these. The reaction is consistently "I forgot we didn't have a videographer."
resources.p_text.want_shareable_clips_fo: Want shareable clips for your group chat and social media?
resources.p_text.watch_3_full_wedding_fi: Watch 3 full wedding films. If the audio is clear, the camera is steady, and the story flows — book them. If any of those three are off, keep looking. Editing skill, not gear, is what separates a $1,500 video from a $5,000 one.
resources.p_text.wedding_video_prices_ra: Wedding video prices range from $500 to $15,000 for the same event. Here's the honest breakdown of what drives the cost, what you can skip, and where the line is between "fair" and "overpriced."
resources.p_text.whether_you_have_raw_fo: Whether you have raw footage, old tapes, or just a collection of photos, we'll help you figure out the right approach. Free quote, 24-hour response, no commitment.
resources.p_text.your_parents_wedding_vi: Your parents' wedding video is 30 years old and degrading. The colors are fading, the audio is muffled, and parts of the tape are unplayable. Here's what's actually recoverable, what isn't, and how to get it done right.
